title: MIND: From Passive Mimicry to Active Reasoning through Capability-Aware Multi-Perspective CoT Distillation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical machine learning method for improving the reasoning capabilities of smaller language models through distillation from larger models. It does not evaluate or benchmark aspects of religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The cognitive 'perspectives' it discusses (e.g., Formal-Symbolic, Intuitive, Decomposition) are related to problem-solving strategies, not ethical frameworks.
